description: In crates/core/src/validation.rs, validate_article_ingress has 5 separate if h.xxx.is_empty() { return Err(MissingMandatoryHeader) } guards (lines ~160-174), followed later by an array-of-pairs loop for the length/NUL checks (lines ~222-245). The two passes over the same 5 mandatory fields are inconsistent. A single pass over an array of (name, &str) pairs could handle both presence and length/NUL checks together, reducing the chance of adding a new mandatory field to one pass but forgetting the other. Low-priority style.
title: validate_article_ingress: mandatory-header presence checks not unified with length checks
